status: Executing regression checks after actual Cinnamon functionality and memory passed; integration held for failed latency

authorization.requirements: Exact gate hash, candidate source commit49, passed/functionalPassed/memoryPassed true, nonempty receipt list with every SHA256 verified. latencyPassed remains false; it is a keep/release blocker rather than a prerequisite for this regression expansion. Guard runs before Replay construction and each subprocess.

sequence: Run prepare-local once: copies only saved candidate source metadata and exact old46 resident identities into a new private output. No Replay construction, guest inspection or secret access.

After root passes the approved Cinnamon functionality and memory prerequisites and supplies their exact SHA, unlock-wake through visible QMP/VNC if needed; inspect its witness. Only then unlock-password --masked-focus-reviewed, using the existing helper's owned0600 regular local login input in memory. Never expose password/sequence; verify unlocked desktop visibly.

stop: revalidate old46 PID/start/executable SHA/manifest, require no UI/no active operations and terminal old journal states, preserve entire synthetic profile and old live metadata; send pidfd SIGTERM to exact resident only and verify exit. No VM lifecycle changes.

guest-build: require this guest's stop receipt; preflight existing distro compiler/CMake/Ninja/Qt>=6.4.2/XCB/Wayland and official SDK. Rebuild candidate49 archive locally in guest with standard dev/release presets and dev tests; preserve all logs and package/source identities. Do not install missing dependencies silently.

install: package-only apt simulation must change only putgd, no removals or additional dependencies; unchanged GNOME extension hash; verify all installed app/CLI/UI and capture-helper identities/versions match guest-built manifest. No capture lastExit requirement on fallback adapters.

start: use existing launcher/environment; verify candidate49 live identity and expected Wayland adapter. Review visible fresh setup, close normally through console, then configure --kind empty for local-only synthetic actions.

matrix: original12 native Qt/GTK capture/clipboard/cancellation cases, VNC output unchanged; preserve each failure and do not silently retry. Review visible acceptance screenshots before asserting native pass.

show --view settings --label settings-open; inspect visible window and normal controls, then close --label settings-closed. Repeat history/activity/about with unique labels. No new UI assertions are inferred from CLI state alone.

memory --seconds300: sixty-one serial whole-family samples, no graphical workload/clipboard/uploads; require one exact resident, no untracked pre-existing UI/capture helpers, no operations, same current identity. Uses frozen ProcessFamily accounting only, not X11 view discovery on Wayland. Save RSS/PSS/private/CPU/raw process identities separately. Can request60 or300seconds explicitly.

After each guest passes, preserve source/package/live manifests, native matrix and UI witnesses plus memory parameters/raw results. Final declared desktop acceptance requires root review. GNOME/KDE phases may run independently in parallel only after Cinnamon gates pass.
limits: No runner phases were executed during preparation; syntax was parsed statically only.
Existing immutable bases remain sealed; runner only reuses current disposable overlays and visible localhost VNC listeners.
No new dependencies, storage credentials, remote uploads or bucket changes.
Guest memory is explicitly post-native-use VM idle evidence; no40MiB or physical-budget promise. GNOME/KDE retain their graphical fallback resident in candidate49.

The inherited unlock helper uses unique fixed console witness names; if a second unlock is required, preserve prior witnesses and deliberately arrange a fresh output/witness attempt rather than overwriting them.

Root must bound actual execution by its09:51UTC experiment deadline; prepared guest-build inherited timeout can exceed the remaining experiment time. Preparation does not authorize continuing beyond the approved scope.
